data.narrative:
CuspAI is a Series A artificial intelligence and software company founded by Max Welling and Chad Edwards that has raised over $100M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of nine private AI & Software peers and one public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR), including later-stage companies such as Scale AI ($29.0B Series B valuation), Reflection AI ($25.0B Series A valuation), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B Series B), Black Forest Labs ($3.2B Series B), and Field AI ($2.0B Series B).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression methodology uses the $100M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A progression, yielding an implied valuation of $200M. The peer-median method examines five same-sector, same- or adjacent-stage comparables, which display a median valuation of $5.6B with a range spanning $2.0B to $29.0B, reflecting substantial dispersion within the AI & Software frontier-tech space.

Triangulation of these two methods supports a valuation range of $170M (low) to $6.4B (high), with a median of $2.9B. The wide range reflects key uncertainties: material differences in stage progression velocity across frontier-tech subsectors and considerable valuation heterogeneity among peer companies, particularly between Series A and Series B financings. Refinement would benefit from further granularity on CuspAI's revenue, growth rate, and technological differentiation relative to the peer set.
